description: This Java source file defines the `ShoppingCartHelper` class, which provides utility methods to manipulate a shopping cart within the OFBiz framework. It includes functionalities such as adding items, bulk adding, deleting, modifying, and managing order agreements and terms. The class interacts with various OFBiz entities and services to support e-commerce shopping cart operations.

classes.name: ShoppingCartHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing shopping cart actions within the OFBiz framework. Provides methods for adding, modifying, deleting items, and managing order agreements and terms.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds a single item to the shopping cart with detailed parameters for product info, reservation, shipping, configuration, and context.

methods.name: addToCartFromOrder
methods.description: Adds items from an existing order to the cart, either all items or specified ones, handling product features and attributes.

methods.name: addCategoryDefaults
methods.description: Adds all products in a category to the cart based on default quantities defined in ProductCategoryMember.

methods.name: addToCartBulk
methods.description: Adds multiple products to the cart based on quantity inputs in the context, handling alternative packing and decimal quantity rules.

methods.name: addToCartBulkRequirements
methods.description: Adds requirement-based items to the cart, such as for planning or order requirements, with support for multiple rows.

methods.name: deleteFromCart
methods.description: Removes items from the cart based on context keys starting with 'DELETE'.

methods.name: modifyCart
methods.description: Updates quantities, descriptions, comments, reservation dates, and other attributes of cart items, also handles deletion if quantity is zero.

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Empties all items from the cart.

methods.name: getCartObject
methods.description: Returns the current ShoppingCart object being managed.

methods.name: selectAgreement
methods.description: Associates an agreement with the cart, updates currency, and loads related terms and conditions.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency for the cart to the specified currency UOM ID.

methods.name: addOrderTerm
methods.description: Associates a term with the current order, such as payment or delivery terms.

methods.name: removeOrderTerm
methods.description: Removes an order term from the cart based on its index.
